notes: Fullscreen is dependable now. The temporary display closes within about a second of quitting a game, so you are never left staring at a zoomed-in screen.
Launching is steadier, and a game that is slow to start is no longer given up on.
The app is now notarized by Apple, so macOS no longer stops you on first launch.
Game windows now show your game's name instead of the client's internal title (no more build dates)
Screen settings (windowed / fullscreen) now apply correctly to every game
Fixed a case where a folder containing a file named Launcher.exe could start the wrong program
Internal: game handling is now fully generic, so any game you add is treated correctly

The x87 compatibility layer now runs inside the game itself instead of the Wine desktop host. Themida-protected clients like MapleEra and MapleLegends finally get the protection they were always meant to have.
64-bit titles such as Ha Repacker now correctly skip the 32-bit compatibility shim, and a shim that cannot load can no longer stop a game from launching at all.
Config recovery no longer resets your per-game settings, hotkeys or selected game after a damaged config file, and can no longer silently drop a game and leave its files to be cleaned up.
A bound hotkey chord no longer leaks through into the game.

New global hotkeys while you're in a game: jump straight to Client 1-4 (⌥1-⌥4), minimize (⌥M) or mute (⌥U) the client you're playing, Solo Audio (⌥⇧U) to hear only that client, Launch Another Client (⌥N), and Show BridgePlay (⌥B)
Optional instant-close hotkey (⌥W) — off by default, flip it on in Settings → Hotkeys if you want a kill switch
Hotkeys settings rebuilt: every shortcut has its own on/off switch, real key-cap rendering, and duplicate shortcuts are caught and explained
Shortcuts no longer use ⌘, so pressing one can't make your character jump — an old ⌘⌥S binding migrates to ⌥S automatically
Show BridgePlay now reopens the launcher window even if you had closed it
Completes the login-crash fix started in 0.5.3.

MapleRoyals: fixes the crash after entering your PIC and logging in. 0.5.3 removed the bad network library from the installer, but the launcher still reinstalled it on every launch — that path is now fixed too, and existing installs repair themselves on the next launch.
Fixed the What's New window's Close button doing nothing.
Note: your first launch after this update may take longer than usual while the runtime and game prefixes are refreshed. This is expected — let it finish.
Fixes a login crash introduced in 0.5.2.

MapleRoyals: fixed a crash right after entering your PIC and logging in. 0.5.2 shipped a patched network library into the Wine runtime that was never meant to load for every game; it is now only applied on demand, per game, as it was before.
Fixed the What's New window's Close button doing nothing.
Note: your first launch after this update will take longer than usual while the runtime and game prefixes are refreshed. This is expected — let it finish.
Per-client audio mute and a CLIENTS section (mute / close one / close all)
Block macOS Shortcuts per game — stops Spotlight, Mission Control, etc. while the game window is focused
Storage breakdown (Game vs Runtime) and app-wide hover polish
Per-client audio mute and a new CLIENTS section (mute / close one / close all)
Repair Game + automatic cleanup of stuck wine processes
Live launch status so long launches never look frozen

Installer cleanup, rename by double-click, What's New, and a launch log viewer
App-wide hover polish
Deleting a game now completely removes it (game folder, Wine environment, shader cache, desktop shortcuts)
Automatic cleanup of orphaned game folders from older versions — can reclaim many GB
Deletion precisely targets only the chosen game
Double-click a game name to rename it inline (card + details panel)
Clicking outside the name field saves the new name
Details panel Rename button works again
Seamless rename with no flash of the old name
Starting… indication while a game launches (badge + button with spinner)
Double-launch protection while a game is starting
Double-clicking a game card now also selects it
Software update window now always opens in front (settings closes automatically)
Check Now reliably re-shows the update window after it was dismissed
Per-game running status: only the launched game shows as running
Running games show Launch Another / Run Another (N)
Exact client detection, no Screen Recording permission needed
